تبتكرين (form VIII)
# تَبْتَكِرِينَ (tabtakirīna) /tab.ta.ki.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# تُبْتَكَرِينَ (tubtakarīna) /tub.ta.ka.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
